summary: Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc filed a Form 6-K attaching an AIM TR-1 major-holdings notification disclosing that BlackRock, Inc. crossed a disclosure threshold on October 14, 2026, with the issuer notified October 15 and the release dated October 16. BlackRock's total position rose to 6.22% from 6.15%: voting rights attached to shares increased to 5.06% (980,217 shares) from 4.92%, financial instruments fell to 1.15% (223,026), split between 0.75% securities lending and 0.39% cash-settled CFDs. This is a routine passive stake-disclosure filing, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, or transaction terms are stated.
